notes: Pi header pins use physical numbering on raspberry-pi-4-gpio: black wire to pin 9 (GND), purple wire to pin 11 (GPIO17), as highlighted in the image.

The black wire ends in breadboard row 15 and the purple wire in row 18, both at column a. The buzzer covers the right side of the board, so its exact holes are hidden. I assumed its legs are in the same rows, at column e (15t.e and 18t.e), since the dashed highlights run along those rows.
Polarity follows the catalogue: buzzer pin 1 (-) is on the GND row 15, and pin 2 (+) is on the GPIO17 row 18.
No resistor is used because the manual says an active buzzer does not need one.
